description: Palette navigation vectors shared by PaletteNavReducer (Swift) and @cmux/app-test (TypeScript). Format: README.md next to this file.

cases.name: open on the root
open a scope above the root selects its empty-query row
open a scope with a query
unknown scope opens the root with the query
open while open starts fresh
close from outside cancels every level
events while closed do nothing
prefix enters from an empty query
pasted text with a prefix enters with the rest as its query
a prefix after other text is literal
prefix entry can be turned off
a nested scope's prefix is literal at the root
a nested scope's prefix enters from its parent
a prefix at the depth limit is literal
an edit changes only the top level
backspace on an empty scope shows the parent
backspace at the root is consumed and keeps the palette open
prefix then backspace restores the root and its selection
keyword plus Tab enters and consumes the keyword
keyword then backspace returns to the root with an empty query
keywords match trimmed and case-insensitively
a nested keyword at the root is not a keyword: Tab drills the row
a nested keyword enters from its parent
Tab drills into the selected row with the row as context
drill then backspace restores the parent query and selection
Tab on a scope row enters the scope
Tab with nothing to enter opens the Actions menu
Tab on a disabled row with nothing to enter does nothing
Shift-Tab pops whatever the query
Escape pops a pushed level, then clears an opened level's query
Escape on an opened level with an empty query closes
Escape pops a prefix level even with a query
Escape at the root clears, then closes
Return runs the selected row
Return on a scope row enters the scope
a click selects and runs its row
a click on a row that is not shown does nothing
Return on a disabled row does nothing
Return waits for the current query and runs on its first batch
a held Return on a scope row enters it when fresh rows land
a pop drops a held Return
a batch of an older generation is dropped
a batch for a popped level is dropped
streamed batches append, dedupe and keep the selection
the first batch of a new generation replaces the rows
a query change selects the default row
refresh keeps the selection by id
refresh keeps the selection by index when the id is gone
refresh clamps the kept index to the last row
refresh with no rows clears the selection
arrow keys wrap
arrow keys wrap past the end
select picks a shown row and ignores an unknown id
a breadcrumb click pops every level above it
a breadcrumb click on a middle chip keeps that level
a breadcrumb click on the top chip does nothing
depth is bounded
command pages push outside the graph
Escape pops a command page and restores the query
the graph drops colliding and invalid prefixes and keywords
a keyword that lost a collision does not enter
an invalid prefix is literal
